# Launch team photos: prompts for ChatGPT or Gemini

The LYRA demo uses six launch and production shops. Each shows three portfolio photos (18 images in all).

**How to use**
- Each prompt already ends with its style line. Copy the whole block into ChatGPT or Gemini.
- Save each image into this folder (`public/vendors/`) under the file name shown above its prompt.
- The site swaps the colour tile for the photo within a few seconds. No restart needed.
- `-1` is the shop's cover. Short on time? Do the six `-1` images first.
- Regenerate any image that comes back with text, a logo or a real artist's face in it.

| Shop | Role | Files |
|---|---|---|
| Studio V | Venue: black-box studio | `v_studiov-1..3.jpg` |
| Neon Works | Stage, LED, light & sound | `v_neonworks-1..3.jpg` |
| Form Lab | Set & installation | `v_formlab-1..3.jpg` |
